summary: Backend + frontend testing for Competitor Price Tracking (Modules 1-3). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases passed against /api/competitor/* endpoints (products listing with search/category/brand/match_status filters, pagination, price-settings PUT, category-rules CRUD, dashboard stats, scan-all/scan-status/scan-stop, price-changes). Frontend: /products page loads 4186 products with 30 rows/page; category filter shows 90 options (9 top + 79 sub), brand filter 56 options (55 brands + all), match-status filter works (matched=1 row, unmatched works), search 'Tava' filters correctly, pagination Next works, detail modal opens on eye icon click. /price-tracking page loads with 4 stat cards (Toplam 4186, Eşleşmiş 1, Rakip 0, Öneri 0). Add Rule dialog: category select populated from real categories, saved rule with 25% margin + 150 TL undercut successfully and it displayed in the list. Scan-all triggered from backend test caused stop-scan-btn to be shown on UI (expected). Login via /login works with arigastro credentials.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> is not a valid child of <option> in category-filter and brand-filter dropdowns (line 219/235/236). Appears to be triggered by dev-time visual-editor instrumentation wrapping dynamic {categories.length}. Cosmetic warning only; does not affect functionality but should be silenced by moving the count outside the <option> label or unwrapping the dynamic expression.

passed_tests: GET /api/competitor/products returns products, categories(>=5), sub_categories, brands(>=20), total, pages
Pagination works (page 1 vs page 2 different slugs)
GET /api/competitor/dashboard returns all stat keys and category_rules array
POST /api/competitor/scan-all starts scan; scan-status + scan-stop respond
Frontend /products loads with 4186 products; 90 category options; 56 brand options
Frontend search 'Tava' filters rows correctly (first row contains 'tava')
Frontend product detail modal opens on eye icon
Frontend /price-tracking page loads with 4 stat cards populated
Frontend Add Rule dialog saves rule and displays it in the rules list
action_items: (Low priority) Fix the <span> inside <option> React warning in CompetitorProductsPage.js lines 219/235 — the visual-editor instrumentation is inserting a <span> inside the <option> element, which triggers a hydration warning. Consider using a non-instrumented expression or hoisting the text outside the option.

(Note) Only one product is marked as 'Eşleşmiş' in the whole catalog (matched=1) — expected per test data seed. Auto-match / ScraperAPI actions won't succeed in preview environment per problem statement.
critical_code_review_comments: competitor_routes.py is 638 lines and mixes list, match, price, category-rule and scan logic — consider splitting into competitor_products.py / competitor_matching.py / competitor_scan.py for maintainability.

list_products_enhanced applies match_status filter AFTER pagination (post-filter on already-sliced page), so a page can appear shorter than 'limit' when filtering matched/unmatched. Consider aggregating match_count in the DB query and filtering pre-pagination for accurate paging.
PriceSettingsRequest accepts optional floor_price/purchase_price but does not validate against negative values or ensure floor <= sale price — worth adding pydantic Field(ge=0).
delete_category_rule always returns success even if the category_name did not exist — consider 404 on missing.
CompetitorProductsPage.js is 607 lines — long file with table row rendering inline; extracting <ProductRow /> and <FiltersBar /> would improve readability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (products page, filters, modal, price-tracking dashboard, add-rule dialog)

seed_data_creation: During the test, a temporary category rule for 'Ana Mutfak Ekipmanları' with margin=25% undercut=150 was saved via the UI (this overwrote the seeded rule of 20% / 100 TL). Also PUT price-settings ran on the first product on page (aluminyum-yapismaz-tava-maksi-24-cm) with floor=111.5 purchase=88.25 — this overwrote the seeded 500/350 values. Main agent may want to re-seed if the specific 500/350 & 20%/100TL values are needed for further QA.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Module 1-3 competitor endpoints and UI flows are healthy. Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_competitor_endpoints.py (15 tests). Note: category-rule for 'Ana Mutfak Ekipmanları' now has 25%/150TL (overwritten during testing), and product 'aluminyum-yapismaz-tava-maksi-24-cm' floor/purchase = 111.5/88.25. Only 1 product is 'matched'; auto-match & ScraperAPI calls will fail in preview (network boundary) — do not treat as bug. Frontend has a benign React hydration warning about <span> inside <option> — needs cleanup but not a blocker.
